Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class RemoveDuplicates

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.StoryGraphTool
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.SimpleStoryGraphTool
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.RemoveDuplicates
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Task
public class RemoveDuplicates extends SimpleStoryGraphTool
A story graph tool that replaces duplicate elements in a story graph to save memory.

Specifically, after this tool has been run:

  • All nodes that have the same state will use the same state object.
  • Any nodes which are duplicates have been replaced so that the graph no longer contains any duplicate nodes. Nodes are considered duplicates if they have all the same fluent values, all the same utilities, and if their outgoing epistemic and temporal edges lead to equivalent nodes (see the ReplaceDuplicateNodes task for more detail).
  • All explanations that have the same plan will use the same plan object.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
